# What does one driving-school car really earn, and should you instruct, employ or lease it out?

> Free driving school calculator: enter lesson, block-lesson and road-test prices, car minutes, fuel and wear, cancellation rate, rent and instructor pay, and see profit per lesson and per car hour, the price for your target margin, break-even lessons per week and whether to employ an instructor or lease the car.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
